Metadata.Name: Change Management
Metadata.Description: Multi-stage change approval workflow with manager sign-off, team supervisor review, CAB assessment, date-targeted implementation, and post-implementation review.
Metadata.Author: Demo

Step.Title: Submit Change Request
Step.Description: Requester fills out the RFC (Request for Change) form with all required details.

Step.Title: Manager Approval
Step.Description: The submitter's manager reviews and approves or rejects the change request.
Step.Definition: {"form_id":"form-manager","assigned_group_id":"group-managers","description":"Review the change request submitted by your team member. Approve to proceed to affected team review, or reject with feedback.","routes":[{"expression":"data['approval_decision'] == 'approved'","target_step_id":"step-3"},{"expression":"data['approval_decision'] == 'rejected'","target_step_id":"step-9"}],"default_target_step_id":"step-9"}

Step.Title: Affected Team Supervisor Approval
Step.Description: The supervisor of the team affected by this change reviews and approves or rejects.
Step.Definition: {"form_id":"form-supervisor","assigned_group_id":"group-team-supervisors","description":"Review the change request that affects your team. Confirm the implementation plan, rollback strategy, and scheduling are acceptable.","routes":[{"expression":"data['approval_decision'] == 'approved'","target_step_id":"step-4"},{"expression":"data['approval_decision'] == 'rejected'","target_step_id":"step-9"}],"default_target_step_id":"step-9"}

Step.Title: CAB Review
Step.Description: The Change Advisory Board performs final risk assessment and scheduling confirmation.
Step.Definition: {"form_id":"form-cab","assigned_group_id":"group-cab","description":"Final approval gate. Assess overall risk, confirm scheduling doesn't conflict with other changes, and authorize or reject.","routes":[{"expression":"data['approval_decision'] == 'approved'","target_step_id":"step-5"},{"expression":"data['approval_decision'] == 'rejected'","target_step_id":"step-9"}],"default_target_step_id":"step-9"}

Step.Title: Set Implementation Date Target
Step.Description: Evaluates the target end date from the change request and creates a calendar-based deadline for tracking.

Step.Title: Implement Change
Step.Description: The implementation team executes the approved change within the target window.
Step.Definition: {"form_id":"form-implementation","assigned_group_id":"group-change-impl-team","description":"Execute the approved change. Complete within the target window and document results. This task is tracked against a calendar date target, not a traditional OLA.","next_step_ids":["step-7"]}

Step.Title: Post-Implementation Review
Step.Description: Document lessons learned and confirm the change is stable.
Step.Definition: {"form_id":"form-pir","assigned_group_id":"group-team-supervisors","description":"Review the implemented change. Confirm stability, document lessons learned, and determine if follow-up is required.","next_step_ids":["step-8"]}

Step.Title: Notify Change Complete
Step.Description: Send completion notification to the requester and stakeholders.
Step.Definition:
{"to":"$input.requester_email","subject":"Change Complete: $input.change_title","body":"Your change request has been completed.

Change: $input.change_title
Outcome: $input.change_outcome
Stable: $input.stable_confirmation

Lessons Learned: $input.lessons_learned
Follow-up Required: $input.follow_up_required","next_step_ids":[]}

Step.Title: Notify Change Rejected
Step.Description: Send rejection notification to the requester with feedback.
Step.Definition:
{"to":"$input.requester_email","subject":"Change Request Rejected: $input.change_title","body":"Your change request has been rejected.

Change: $input.change_title
Reason: $input.approval_decision
Comments: $input.manager_comments

Please address the feedback and resubmit if appropriate.","next_step_ids":[]}
